audio.text: Should I print the report or just send it by email?

options: I sent you an email yesterday.
The report is about twenty pages long, I think.

why.en: An indirect answer to an either/or question (→ print it). C answers "yes" to a choice.
why.tr: Seçim sorusuna dolaylı yanıt (→ yazdır). C seçim sorusuna "evet" diyor.
why.es: Una respuesta indirecta a una pregunta de "esto o aquello" (→ imprimirlo). C responde "sí" a una elección.
